name: Fallen Angels
overview: The Bible reveals that fallen angels are spiritual beings who rebelled against God, as seen in Jude 1:6 where they abandoned their proper place and are now reserved for judgment. Their opposition to God and His people is highlighted in Revelation 12:7, describing a heavenly conflict between Michael and these rebellious angels. Jesus warns in Matthew 25:41 of eternal punishment prepared for the devil and his angels, emphasizing their destined condemnation. Believers are reminded in Ephesians 6:12 that their true struggle is against these spiritual forces of darkness, not merely against human adversaries.
